decisions.decision: The board agreed to the school social meeting sponsored by the LHS Student Council at the library, to be held in the 1st or 2nd week in December, chaperoned by student council advisers; Steven Flaherty will work with Kate McCaron to organize it.
decisions.quote: board agrees to this proposal and steven will work with kate mccaron to organize the event.

decisions.decision: A draft library budget request will be created and passed to Kerry with a note that it still needs Trustee approval; the budget request is due December 22, 2010, and a budget subcommittee will meet before the next Trustees meeting.
decisions.quote: budget request due december 22, 2010. will create a draft, pass on to kerry with note saying still needs approval by trustees.

budget_items.topic: Director's report: utilities and municipal rate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Utilities were a little over, and the library's municipal rate will increase due to the new sewage rates; no figures printed.
budget_items.quote: utilities a little over (probably due to parking lights and air conditioning)

budget_items.topic: Director's report: Friends pledge and State Aid
budget_items.what_was_recorded: North Middlesex completed its final pledge to the Friends of LPL and a State Aid installment will arrive soon.
budget_items.quote: north middlesex completed final pledge to the friends of lpl of $3,333.33 and the state aid installment of $6, 068.79 will arrive soon.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Friends Oktoberfest netted a little over $800 for the Endowment.

budget_items.topic: Town Manager's preliminary FY 2012 budget: tax rate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The state average tax rate is a 9% decrease, and a level-service budget was presented.
budget_items.quote: tax rate state average is 9% decrease.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposed additional paraprofessional staff person at 19 hours per week, no benefits.
budget_items.quote: additional paraprofessional staff person; 19 hours at $13/hour, no benefits.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Adding 4 Friday hours (10 am-2 pm) at a stated cost per hour, split between staff and utilities.
budget_items.quote: add friday hours: 4 hours, 10 am-2 pm. cost - $100/hr: $80 for staff, $20 for utilities.
